note: Jefferson County has no countywide zoning; each municipality zones its own land. Brookville publishes its zoning map only as static PDF sheets (2006 mapbook), Punxsutawney's map is on file at the borough office with code on ecode360. The DuBois/Sandy consolidated layer (FeatureServer/9) lies in Clearfield County, not Jefferson, and the county GIS viewer exposes no zoning service. No queryable zoning polygons exist for Jefferson County.
